{"content":"# gh-1624 rework — review threads addressed

## Issues/Notes

- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqplU`** — `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` were rendered only on the `FA_PROVIDER_*` boot notice; the provider-queue chain and the `--model`/`--base-url` revalidation dropped them (silent riders). **Fixed.**
- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqpo9`** — the "known endpoint" scoping kept the vendor-prefix verdict fatal on known ROUTER endpoints (OpenRouter's canonical ids are `anthropic/claude-*`/`google/gemini-*` → still exit 64), contradicting the doc claim "routers … pass". **Fixed via option (a).**
- 💡 **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqptD`** — `docs/agents/providers.md` over-broadened the family verdict's scope (it fires only on the three family-exclusive endpoints, never on routers). **Fixed.**
- The remaining 3 open conversations in `pr_discussions_raw.json` carry no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` and are machine notices (review-verdict record, rework-consume audit, and the APPROVE summary comment) — not reply targets, nothing to fix in code.
- CI was green at rework start; no merge conflicts.

## Approach

- **Warnings on every resolve path (thread 1).** `buildProviderQueueChain` gained a `warnings` out-channel (the `skipped` pattern) emitting render-ready `warning: binding — <entry>: <note>` lines; all three queue rebuild sites render them — boot (`ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)` → the provider-queue boot notices in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`), REPL queue reload (`_rebuildProviderQueueRuntime`), and `/provider queue test`. `_revalidatePartialOverride` now returns the effective binding's warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` carries them as a new `bindingWarnings` report field and the boot prints them (`warning: binding — …`, next to the other restore warnings). Warnings the active `FA_PROVIDER_*` binding already carries are deduped so the preconfig notice never double-prints. Secondary nit done: `warnings` is pinned `List.unmodifiable`.
- **Router endpoints (thread 2, option a).** The prefix verdict's fatal scope now mirrors the family branch exactly: fatal only when the endpoint carries a dialect verdict (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect(baseUrl) != null` — the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints); routers and unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a warning ("this endpoint carries no dialect verdict … routing key"). gh-1570 fail-fast is preserved on the vendor endpoints in both directions. The minor is done too: the three catalog-scan copies collapsed into one shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint(baseUrl)` helper (`_validateWireEndpoint`, `_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`, the prefix verdict); `_knownCatalogEndpoint` removed. The line-366 doc claim ("unknown ids, routers and unknown endpoints pass") is true again.
- **Docs (thread 3).** `docs/agents/providers.md` states the exact scope (both verdicts fire only on api.anthropic.com / api.openai.com / generativelanguage; routers never carry a verdict — `claude-*` on an openai-completions binding over OpenRouter passes) and names where the warning renders; README, `--help` text and the CHANGELOG entry updated to the same scope.
- TDD throughout: each thread reproduced by a failing test first (the OpenRouter probe reproduced the thread's exact `ConfigException`), then the minimum fix turned it green.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` — router-aware verdict scoping, shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint`, unmodifiable `warnings`, dartdocs.
- `lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart` — `buildProviderQueueChain(warnings:)` out-channel; `ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)`.
- `lib/src/cli/startup.dart` — `_revalidatePartialOverride` returns (deduped) binding warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` record gains `bindingWarnings`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_commands.dart` — queue reload + `/provider queue test` render the warnings.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — boot renders queue binding warnings and the flag-path `bindingWarnings`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_help.dart`, `README.md`, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` — scope-accurate docs.

## Test Coverage

- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` — new "review" tests in the gh-1624 REG group: OpenRouter canonical-id probe (`anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet`, `google/gemini-2.0-flash`) resolves with a routing-key warning instead of exit 64; family-exclusive vendor endpoints stay fatal in both directions; `warnings` rejects mutation (`throwsUnsupportedError`).
- `test/model_roles/providers_queue_test.dart` — the private-endpoint/foreign-prefix queue entry chains loudly (entry-labelled warning line); a quiet entry leaves the channel empty; `ProviderQueueRuntime.build` forwards warnings to `onBindingWarning`.
- `test/cli/startup_test.dart` — `--model` over a saved private-endpoint binding surfaces the warning via `bindingWarnings`; the active-preconfig duplicate is suppressed.
- Touched suites green after the fix: binding + queue + startup + env-preconfig + the bifrost loopback IT (230 passed). Full unit suite (`dart test --exclude-tags integration`) run recorded in the rework validation.

{"content":"# gh-1624 rework — review threads addressed

## Issues/Notes

- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqplU`** — `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` were rendered only on the `FA_PROVIDER_*` boot notice; the provider-queue chain and the `--model`/`--base-url` revalidation dropped them (silent riders). **Fixed.**
- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqpo9`** — the "known endpoint" scoping kept the vendor-prefix verdict fatal on known ROUTER endpoints (OpenRouter's canonical ids are `anthropic/claude-*`/`google/gemini-*` → still exit 64), contradicting the doc claim "routers … pass". **Fixed via option (a).**
- 💡 **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqptD`** — `docs/agents/providers.md` over-broadened the family verdict's scope (it fires only on the three family-exclusive endpoints, never on routers). **Fixed.**
- The remaining 3 open conversations in `pr_discussions_raw.json` carry no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` and are machine notices (review-verdict record, rework-consume audit, and the APPROVE summary comment) — not reply targets, nothing to fix in code.
- CI was green at rework start; no merge conflicts.

## Approach

- **Warnings on every resolve path (thread 1).** `buildProviderQueueChain` gained a `warnings` out-channel (the `skipped` pattern) emitting render-ready `warning: binding — <entry>: <note>` lines; all three queue rebuild sites render them — boot (`ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)` → the provider-queue boot notices in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`), REPL queue reload (`_rebuildProviderQueueRuntime`), and `/provider queue test`. `_revalidatePartialOverride` now returns the effective binding's warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` carries them as a new `bindingWarnings` report field and the boot prints them (`warning: binding — …`, next to the other restore warnings). Warnings the active `FA_PROVIDER_*` binding already carries are deduped so the preconfig notice never double-prints. Secondary nit done: `warnings` is pinned `List.unmodifiable`.
- **Router endpoints (thread 2, option a).** The prefix verdict's fatal scope now mirrors the family branch exactly: fatal only when the endpoint carries a dialect verdict (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect(baseUrl) != null` — the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints); routers and unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a warning ("this endpoint carries no dialect verdict … routing key"). gh-1570 fail-fast is preserved on the vendor endpoints in both directions. The minor is done too: the three catalog-scan copies collapsed into one shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint(baseUrl)` helper (`_validateWireEndpoint`, `_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`, the prefix verdict); `_knownCatalogEndpoint` removed. The line-366 doc claim ("unknown ids, routers and unknown endpoints pass") is true again.
- **Docs (thread 3).** `docs/agents/providers.md` states the exact scope (both verdicts fire only on api.anthropic.com / api.openai.com / generativelanguage; routers never carry a verdict — `claude-*` on an openai-completions binding over OpenRouter passes) and names where the warning renders; README, `--help` text and the CHANGELOG entry updated to the same scope.
- TDD throughout: each thread reproduced by a failing test first (the OpenRouter probe reproduced the thread's exact `ConfigException`), then the minimum fix turned it green.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` — router-aware verdict scoping, shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint`, unmodifiable `warnings`, dartdocs.
- `lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart` — `buildProviderQueueChain(warnings:)` out-channel; `ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)`.
- `lib/src/cli/startup.dart` — `_revalidatePartialOverride` returns (deduped) binding warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` record gains `bindingWarnings`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_commands.dart` — queue reload + `/provider queue test` render the warnings.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — boot renders queue binding warnings and the flag-path `bindingWarnings`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_help.dart`, `README.md`, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` — scope-accurate docs.

## Test Coverage

- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` — new "review" tests in the gh-1624 REG group: OpenRouter canonical-id probe (`anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet`, `google/gemini-2.0-flash`) resolves with a routing-key warning instead of exit 64; family-exclusive vendor endpoints stay fatal in both directions; `warnings` rejects mutation (`throwsUnsupportedError`).
- `test/model_roles/providers_queue_test.dart` — the private-endpoint/foreign-prefix queue entry chains loudly (entry-labelled warning line); a quiet entry leaves the channel empty; `ProviderQueueRuntime.build` forwards warnings to `onBindingWarning`.
- `test/cli/startup_test.dart` — `--model` over a saved private-endpoint binding surfaces the warning via `bindingWarnings`; the active-preconfig duplicate is suppressed.

{"content":"# gh-1624 rework — review threads addressed

## Issues/Notes

- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqplU`** — `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` were rendered only on the `FA_PROVIDER_*` boot notice; the provider-queue chain and the `--model`/`--base-url` revalidation dropped them (silent riders). **Fixed.**
- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqpo9`** — the "known endpoint" scoping kept the vendor-prefix verdict fatal on known ROUTER endpoints (OpenRouter's canonical ids are `anthropic/claude-*`/`google/gemini-*` → still exit 64), contradicting the doc claim "routers … pass". **Fixed via option (a).**
- 💡 **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqptD`** — `docs/agents/providers.md` over-broadened the family verdict's scope (it fires only on the three family-exclusive endpoints, never on routers). **Fixed.**
- The remaining 3 open conversations in `pr_discussions_raw.json` carry no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` and are machine notices (review-verdict record, rework-consume audit, and the APPROVE summary comment) — not reply targets, nothing to fix in code.
- CI was green at rework start; no merge conflicts.

## Approach

- **Warnings on every resolve path (thread 1).** `buildProviderQueueChain` gained a `warnings` out-channel (the `skipped` pattern) emitting render-ready `warning: binding — <entry>: <note>` lines; all three queue rebuild sites render them — boot (`ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)` → the provider-queue boot notices in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`), REPL queue reload (`_rebuildProviderQueueRuntime`), and `/provider queue test`. `_revalidatePartialOverride` now returns the effective binding's warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` carries them as a new `bindingWarnings` report field and the boot prints them (`warning: binding — …`, next to the other restore warnings). Warnings the active `FA_PROVIDER_*` binding already carries are deduped so the preconfig notice never double-prints. Secondary nit done: `warnings` is pinned `List.unmodifiable`.
- **Router endpoints (thread 2, option a).** The prefix verdict's fatal scope now mirrors the family branch exactly: fatal only when the endpoint carries a dialect verdict (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect(baseUrl) != null` — the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints); routers and unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a warning ("this endpoint carries no dialect verdict … routing key"). gh-1570 fail-fast is preserved on the vendor endpoints in both directions. The minor is done too: the three catalog-scan copies collapsed into one shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint(baseUrl)` helper (`_validateWireEndpoint`, `_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`, the prefix verdict); `_knownCatalogEndpoint` removed. The line-366 doc claim ("unknown ids, routers and unknown endpoints pass") is true again.
- **Docs (thread 3).** `docs/agents/providers.md` states the exact scope (both verdicts fire only on api.anthropic.com / api.openai.com / generativelanguage; routers never carry a verdict — `claude-*` on an openai-completions binding over OpenRouter passes) and names where the warning renders; README, `--help` text and the CHANGELOG entry updated to the same scope.
- TDD throughout: each thread reproduced by a failing test first (the OpenRouter probe reproduced the thread's exact `ConfigException`), then the minimum fix turned it green.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` — router-aware verdict scoping, shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint`, unmodifiable `warnings`, dartdocs.
- `lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart` — `buildProviderQueueChain(warnings:)` out-channel; `ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)`.
- `lib/src/cli/startup.dart` — `_revalidatePartialOverride` returns (deduped) binding warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` record gains `bindingWarnings`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_commands.dart` — queue reload + `/provider queue test` render the warnings.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — boot renders queue binding warnings and the flag-path `bindingWarnings`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_help.dart`, `README.md`, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` — scope-accurate docs.

## Test Coverage

- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` — new "review" tests in the gh-1624 REG group: OpenRouter canonical-id probe (`anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet`, `google/gemini-2.0-flash`) resolves with a routing-key warning instead of exit 64; family-exclusive vendor endpoints stay fatal in both directions; `warnings` rejects mutation (`throwsUnsupportedError`).
- `test/model_roles/providers_queue_test.dart` — the private-endpoint/foreign-prefix queue entry chains loudly (entry-labelled warning line); a quiet entry leaves the channel empty; `ProviderQueueRuntime.build` forwards warnings to `onBindingWarning`.

{"content":"# gh-1624 rework — review threads addressed

## Issues/Notes

- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqplU`** — `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` were rendered only on the `FA_PROVIDER_*` boot notice; the provider-queue chain and the `--model`/`--base-url` revalidation dropped them (silent riders). **Fixed.**
- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqpo9`** — the "known endpoint" scoping kept the vendor-prefix verdict fatal on known ROUTER endpoints (OpenRouter's canonical ids are `anthropic/claude-*`/`google/gemini-*` → still exit 64), contradicting the doc claim "routers … pass". **Fixed via option (a).**
- 💡 **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqptD`** — `docs/agents/providers.md` over-broadened the family verdict's scope (it fires only on the three family-exclusive endpoints, never on routers). **Fixed.**
- The remaining 3 open conversations in `pr_discussions_raw.json` carry no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` and are machine notices (review-verdict record, rework-consume audit, and the APPROVE summary comment) — not reply targets, nothing to fix in code.
- CI was green at rework start; no merge conflicts.

## Approach

- **Warnings on every resolve path (thread 1).** `buildProviderQueueChain` gained a `warnings` out-channel (the `skipped` pattern) emitting render-ready `warning: binding — <entry>: <note>` lines; all three queue rebuild sites render them — boot (`ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)` → the provider-queue boot notices in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`), REPL queue reload (`_rebuildProviderQueueRuntime`), and `/provider queue test`. `_revalidatePartialOverride` now returns the effective binding's warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` carries them as a new `bindingWarnings` report field and the boot prints them (`warning: binding — …`, next to the other restore warnings). Warnings the active `FA_PROVIDER_*` binding already carries are deduped so the preconfig notice never double-prints. Secondary nit done: `warnings` is pinned `List.unmodifiable`.
- **Router endpoints (thread 2, option a).** The prefix verdict's fatal scope now mirrors the family branch exactly: fatal only when the endpoint carries a dialect verdict (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect(baseUrl) != null` — the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints); routers and unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a warning ("this endpoint carries no dialect verdict … routing key"). gh-1570 fail-fast is preserved on the vendor endpoints in both directions. The minor is done too: the three catalog-scan copies collapsed into one shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint(baseUrl)` helper (`_validateWireEndpoint`, `_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`, the prefix verdict); `_knownCatalogEndpoint` removed. The line-366 doc claim ("unknown ids, routers and unknown endpoints pass") is true again.
- **Docs (thread 3).** `docs/agents/providers.md` states the exact scope (both verdicts fire only on api.anthropic.com / api.openai.com / generativelanguage; routers never carry a verdict — `claude-*` on an openai-completions binding over OpenRouter passes) and names where the warning renders; README, `--help` text and the CHANGELOG entry updated to the same scope.
- TDD throughout: each thread reproduced by a failing test first (the OpenRouter probe reproduced the thread's exact `ConfigException`), then the minimum fix turned it green.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` — router-aware verdict scoping, shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint`, unmodifiable `warnings`, dartdocs.
- `lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart` — `buildProviderQueueChain(warnings:)` out-channel; `ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)`.
- `lib/src/cli/startup.dart` — `_revalidatePartialOverride` returns (deduped) binding warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` record gains `bindingWarnings`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_commands.dart` — queue reload + `/provider queue test` render the warnings.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — boot renders queue binding warnings and the flag-path `bindingWarnings`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_help.dart`, `README.md`, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` — scope-accurate docs.

## Test Coverage

- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` — new "review" tests in the gh-1624 REG group: OpenRouter canonical-id probe (`anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet`, `google/gemini-2.0-flash`) resolves with a routing-key warning instead of exit 64; family-exclusive vendor endpoints stay fatal in both directions; `warnings` rejects mutation (`throwsUnsupportedError`).
- `test/model_roles/providers_queue_test.dart` — the private-endpoint/foreign-prefix queue entry chains loudly (entry-labelled warning line); a quiet entry leaves the channel empty; `ProviderQueueRuntime.build` forwards warnings to `onBindingWarning`.
- `test/cli/startup_test.dart` — `--model` over a saved private-endpoint binding surfaces the warning via `bindingWarnings`; the active-preconfig duplicate is suppressed.

{"content":"# gh-1624 rework — review threads addressed

## Issues/Notes

- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqplU`** — `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` were rendered only on the `FA_PROVIDER_*` boot notice; the provider-queue chain and the `--model`/`--base-url` revalidation dropped them (silent riders). **Fixed.**
- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqpo9`** — the "known endpoint" scoping kept the vendor-prefix verdict fatal on known ROUTER endpoints (OpenRouter's canonical ids are `anthropic/claude-*`/`google/gemini-*` → still exit 64), contradicting the doc claim "routers … pass". **Fixed via option (a).**
- 💡 **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqptD`** — `docs/agents/providers.md` over-broadened the family verdict's scope (it fires only on the three family-exclusive endpoints, never on routers). **Fixed.**
- The remaining 3 open conversations in `pr_discussions_raw.json` carry no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` and are machine notices (review-verdict record, rework-consume audit, and the APPROVE summary comment) — not reply targets, nothing to fix in code.
- CI was green at rework start; no merge conflicts.

## Approach

- **Warnings on every resolve path (thread 1).** `buildProviderQueueChain` gained a `warnings` out-channel (the `skipped` pattern) emitting render-ready `warning: binding — <entry>: <note>` lines; all three queue rebuild sites render them — boot (`ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)` → the provider-queue boot notices in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`), REPL queue reload (`_rebuildProviderQueueRuntime`), and `/provider queue test`. `_revalidatePartialOverride` now returns the effective binding's warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` carries them as a new `bindingWarnings` report field and the boot prints them (`warning: binding — …`, next to the other restore warnings). Warnings the active `FA_PROVIDER_*` binding already carries are deduped so the preconfig notice never double-prints. Secondary nit done: `warnings` is pinned `List.unmodifiable`.
- **Router endpoints (thread 2, option a).** The prefix verdict's fatal scope now mirrors the family branch exactly: fatal only when the endpoint carries a dialect verdict (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect(baseUrl) != null` — the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints); routers and unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a warning ("this endpoint carries no dialect verdict … routing key"). gh-1570 fail-fast is preserved on the vendor endpoints in both directions. The minor is done too: the three catalog-scan copies collapsed into one shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint(baseUrl)` helper (`_validateWireEndpoint`, `_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`, the prefix verdict); `_knownCatalogEndpoint` removed. The line-366 doc claim ("unknown ids, routers and unknown endpoints pass") is true again.
- **Docs (thread 3).** `docs/agents/providers.md` states the exact scope (both verdicts fire only on api.anthropic.com / api.openai.com / generativelanguage; routers never carry a verdict — `claude-*` on an openai-completions binding over OpenRouter passes) and names where the warning renders; README, `--help` text and the CHANGELOG entry updated to the same scope.
- TDD throughout: each thread reproduced by a failing test first (the OpenRouter probe reproduced the thread's exact `ConfigException`), then the minimum fix turned it green.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` — router-aware verdict scoping, shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint`, unmodifiable `warnings`, dartdocs.
- `lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart` — `buildProviderQueueChain(warnings:)` out-channel; `ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)`.
- `lib/src/cli/startup.dart` — `_revalidatePartialOverride` returns (deduped) binding warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` record gains `bindingWarnings`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_commands.dart` — queue reload + `/provider queue test` render the warnings.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — boot renders queue binding warnings and the flag-path `bindingWarnings`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_help.dart`, `README.md`, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` — scope-accurate docs.

## Test Coverage

{"content":"# gh-1624 rework — review threads addressed

## Issues/Notes

- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqplU`** — `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` were rendered only on the `FA_PROVIDER_*` boot notice; the provider-queue chain and the `--model`/`--base-url` revalidation dropped them (silent riders). **Fixed.**
- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqpo9`** — the "known endpoint" scoping kept the vendor-prefix verdict fatal on known ROUTER endpoints (OpenRouter's canonical ids are `anthropic/claude-*`/`google/gemini-*` → still exit 64), contradicting the doc claim "routers … pass". **Fixed via option (a).**
- 💡 **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqptD`** — `docs/agents/providers.md` over-broadened the family verdict's scope (it fires only on the three family-exclusive endpoints, never on routers). **Fixed.**
- The remaining 3 open conversations in `pr_discussions_raw.json` carry no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` and are machine notices (review-verdict record, rework-consume audit, and the APPROVE summary comment) — not reply targets, nothing to fix in code.
- CI was green at rework start; no merge conflicts.

## Approach

- **Warnings on every resolve path (thread 1).** `buildProviderQueueChain` gained a `warnings` out-channel (the `skipped` pattern) emitting render-ready `warning: binding — <entry>: <note>` lines; all three queue rebuild sites render them — boot (`ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)` → the provider-queue boot notices in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`), REPL queue reload (`_rebuildProviderQueueRuntime`), and `/provider queue test`. `_revalidatePartialOverride` now returns the effective binding's warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` carries them as a new `bindingWarnings` report field and the boot prints them (`warning: binding — …`, next to the other restore warnings). Warnings the active `FA_PROVIDER_*` binding already carries are deduped so the preconfig notice never double-prints. Secondary nit done: `warnings` is pinned `List.unmodifiable`.
- **Router endpoints (thread 2, option a).** The prefix verdict's fatal scope now mirrors the family branch exactly: fatal only when the endpoint carries a dialect verdict (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect(baseUrl) != null` — the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints); routers and unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a warning ("this endpoint carries no dialect verdict … routing key"). gh-1570 fail-fast is preserved on the vendor endpoints in both directions. The minor is done too: the three catalog-scan copies collapsed into one shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint(baseUrl)` helper (`_validateWireEndpoint`, `_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`, the prefix verdict); `_knownCatalogEndpoint` removed. The line-366 doc claim ("unknown ids, routers and unknown endpoints pass") is true again.
- **Docs (thread 3).** `docs/agents/providers.md` states the exact scope (both verdicts fire only on api.anthropic.com / api.openai.com / generativelanguage; routers never carry a verdict — `claude-*` on an openai-completions binding over OpenRouter passes) and names where the warning renders; README, `--help` text and the CHANGELOG entry updated to the same scope.
- TDD throughout: each thread reproduced by a failing test first (the OpenRouter probe reproduced the thread's exact `ConfigException`), then the minimum fix turned it green.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` — router-aware verdict scoping, shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint`, unmodifiable `warnings`, dartdocs.
- `lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart` — `buildProviderQueueChain(warnings:)` out-channel; `ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)`.
- `lib/src/cli/startup.dart` — `_revalidatePartialOverride` returns (deduped) binding warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` record gains `bindingWarnings`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_commands.dart` — queue reload + `/provider queue test` render the warnings.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — boot renders queue binding warnings and the flag-path `bindingWarnings`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_help.dart`, `README.md`, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` — scope-accurate docs.

## Test Coverage

- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` — new "review" tests in the gh-1624 REG group: OpenRouter canonical-id probe (`anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet`, `google/gemini-2.0-flash`) resolves with a routing-key warning instead of exit 64; family-exclusive vendor endpoints stay fatal in both directions; `warnings` rejects mutation (`throwsUnsupportedError`).
- `test/model_roles/providers_queue_test.dart` — the private-endpoint/foreign-prefix queue entry chains loudly (entry-labelled warning line); a quiet entry leaves the channel empty; `ProviderQueueRuntime.build` forwards warnings to `onBindingWarning`.
- `test/cli/startup_test.dart` — `--model` over a saved private-endpoint binding surfaces the warning via `bindingWarnings`; the active-preconfig duplicate is suppressed.
- Touched suites green after the fix: binding + queue + startup + env-preconfig + the bifrost loopback IT (230 passed). Full unit suite (`dart test --exclude-tags integration`) run recorded in the rework validation.

{"content":"# gh-1624 rework — review threads addressed

## Issues/Notes

- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqplU`** — `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` were rendered only on the `FA_PROVIDER_*` boot notice; the provider-queue chain and the `--model`/`--base-url` revalidation dropped them (silent riders). **Fixed.**
- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqpo9`** — the "known endpoint" scoping kept the vendor-prefix verdict fatal on known ROUTER endpoints (OpenRouter's canonical ids are `anthropic/claude-*`/`google/gemini-*` → still exit 64), contradicting the doc claim "routers … pass". **Fixed via option (a).**
- 💡 **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqptD`** — `docs/agents/providers.md` over-broadened the family verdict's scope (it fires only on the three family-exclusive endpoints, never on routers). **Fixed.**
- The remaining 3 open conversations in `pr_discussions_raw.json` carry no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` and are machine notices (review-verdict record, rework-consume audit, and the APPROVE summary comment) — not reply targets, nothing to fix in code.
- CI was green at rework start; no merge conflicts.

## Approach

- **Warnings on every resolve path (thread 1).** `buildProviderQueueChain` gained a `warnings` out-channel (the `skipped` pattern) emitting render-ready `warning: binding — <entry>: <note>` lines; all three queue rebuild sites render them — boot (`ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)` → the provider-queue boot notices in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`), REPL queue reload (`_rebuildProviderQueueRuntime`), and `/provider queue test`. `_revalidatePartialOverride` now returns the effective binding's warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` carries them as a new `bindingWarnings` report field and the boot prints them (`warning: binding — …`, next to the other restore warnings). Warnings the active `FA_PROVIDER_*` binding already carries are deduped so the preconfig notice never double-prints. Secondary nit done: `warnings` is pinned `List.unmodifiable`.
- **Router endpoints (thread 2, option a).** The prefix verdict's fatal scope now mirrors the family branch exactly: fatal only when the endpoint carries a dialect verdict (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect(baseUrl) != null` — the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints); routers and unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a warning ("this endpoint carries no dialect verdict … routing key"). gh-1570 fail-fast is preserved on the vendor endpoints in both directions. The minor is done too: the three catalog-scan copies collapsed into one shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint(baseUrl)` helper (`_validateWireEndpoint`, `_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`, the prefix verdict); `_knownCatalogEndpoint` removed. The line-366 doc claim ("unknown ids, routers and unknown endpoints pass") is true again.
- **Docs (thread 3).** `docs/agents/providers.md` states the exact scope (both verdicts fire only on api.anthropic.com / api.openai.com / generativelanguage; routers never carry a verdict — `claude-*` on an openai-completions binding over OpenRouter passes) and names where the warning renders; README, `--help` text and the CHANGELOG entry updated to the same scope.
- TDD throughout: each thread reproduced by a failing test first (the OpenRouter probe reproduced the thread's exact `ConfigException`), then the minimum fix turned it green.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` — router-aware verdict scoping, shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint`, unmodifiable `warnings`, dartdocs.
- `lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart` — `buildProviderQueueChain(warnings:)` out-channel; `ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)`.
- `lib/src/cli/startup.dart` — `_revalidatePartialOverride` returns (deduped) binding warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` record gains `bindingWarnings`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_commands.dart` — queue reload + `/provider queue test` render the warnings.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — boot renders queue binding warnings and the flag-path `bindingWarnings`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_help.dart`, `README.md`, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` — scope-accurate docs.

## Test Coverage

- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` — new "review" tests in the gh-1624 REG group: OpenRouter canonical-id probe (`anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet`, `google/gemini-2.0-flash`) resolves with a routing-key warning instead of exit 64; family-exclusive vendor endpoints stay fatal in both directions; `warnings` rejects mutation (`throwsUnsupportedError`).
- `test/model_roles/providers_queue_test.dart` — the private-endpoint/foreign-prefix queue entry chains loudly (entry-labelled warning line); a quiet entry leaves the channel empty; `ProviderQueueRuntime.build` forwards warnings to `onBindingWarning`.
- `test/cli/startup_test.dart` — `--model` over a saved private-endpoint binding surfaces the warning via `bindingWarnings`; the active-preconfig duplicate is suppressed.
- Touched suites green after the fix: binding + queue + startup + env-preconfig + the bifrost loopback IT (230 passed). Full unit suite (`dart test --exclude-tags integration`) run recorded in the rework validation.

{"content":"# gh-1624 rework — review threads addressed

## Issues/Notes

- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqplU`** — `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` were rendered only on the `FA_PROVIDER_*` boot notice; the provider-queue chain and the `--model`/`--base-url` revalidation dropped them (silent riders). **Fixed.**
- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqpo9`** — the "known endpoint" scoping kept the vendor-prefix verdict fatal on known ROUTER endpoints (OpenRouter's canonical ids are `anthropic/claude-*`/`google/gemini-*` → still exit 64), contradicting the doc claim "routers … pass". **Fixed via option (a).**
- 💡 **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqptD`** — `docs/agents/providers.md` over-broadened the family verdict's scope (it fires only on the three family-exclusive endpoints, never on routers). **Fixed.**
- The remaining 3 open conversations in `pr_discussions_raw.json` carry no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` and are machine notices (review-verdict record, rework-consume audit, and the APPROVE summary comment) — not reply targets, nothing to fix in code.
- CI was green at rework start; no merge conflicts.

## Approach

- **Warnings on every resolve path (thread 1).** `buildProviderQueueChain` gained a `warnings` out-channel (the `skipped` pattern) emitting render-ready `warning: binding — <entry>: <note>` lines; all three queue rebuild sites render them — boot (`ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)` → the provider-queue boot notices in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`), REPL queue reload (`_rebuildProviderQueueRuntime`), and `/provider queue test`. `_revalidatePartialOverride` now returns the effective binding's warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` carries them as a new `bindingWarnings` report field and the boot prints them (`warning: binding — …`, next to the other restore warnings). Warnings the active `FA_PROVIDER_*` binding already carries are deduped so the preconfig notice never double-prints. Secondary nit done: `warnings` is pinned `List.unmodifiable`.
- **Router endpoints (thread 2, option a).** The prefix verdict's fatal scope now mirrors the family branch exactly: fatal only when the endpoint carries a dialect verdict (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect(baseUrl) != null` — the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints); routers and unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a warning ("this endpoint carries no dialect verdict … routing key"). gh-1570 fail-fast is preserved on the vendor endpoints in both directions. The minor is done too: the three catalog-scan copies collapsed into one shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint(baseUrl)` helper (`_validateWireEndpoint`, `_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`, the prefix verdict); `_knownCatalogEndpoint` removed. The line-366 doc claim ("unknown ids, routers and unknown endpoints pass") is true again.
- **Docs (thread 3).** `docs/agents/providers.md` states the exact scope (both verdicts fire only on api.anthropic.com / api.openai.com / generativelanguage; routers never carry a verdict — `claude-*` on an openai-completions binding over OpenRouter passes) and names where the warning renders; README, `--help` text and the CHANGELOG entry updated to the same scope.
- TDD throughout: each thread reproduced by a failing test first (the OpenRouter probe reproduced the thread's exact `ConfigException`), then the minimum fix turned it green.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` — router-aware verdict scoping, shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint`, unmodifiable `warnings`, dartdocs.
- `lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart` — `buildProviderQueueChain(warnings:)` out-channel; `ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)`.
- `lib/src/cli/startup.dart` — `_revalidatePartialOverride` returns (deduped) binding warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` record gains `bindingWarnings`.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_commands.dart` — queue reload + `/provider queue test` render the warnings.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — boot renders queue binding warnings and the flag-path `bindingWarnings`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_help.dart`, `README.md`, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` — scope-accurate docs.

## Test Coverage

- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` — new "review" tests in the gh-1624 REG group: OpenRouter canonical-id probe (`anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet`, `google/gemini-2.0-flash`) resolves with a routing-key warning instead of exit 64; family-exclusive vendor endpoints stay fatal in both directions; `warnings` rejects mutation (`throwsUnsupportedError`).
- `test/model_roles/providers_queue_test.dart` — the private-endpoint/foreign-prefix queue entry chains loudly (entry-labelled warning line); a quiet entry leaves the channel empty; `ProviderQueueRuntime.build` forwards warnings to `onBindingWarning`.
- `test/cli/startup_test.dart` — `--model` over a saved private-endpoint binding surfaces the warning via `bindingWarnings`; the active-preconfig duplicate is suppressed.
- Touched suites green after the fix: binding + queue + startup + env-preconfig + the bifrost loopback IT (230 passed). Full unit suite (`dart test --exclude-tags integration`) run recorded in the rework validation.

Warnings the active `FA_PROVIDER_*` binding already carries are deduped so the preconfig notice never double-prints. Secondary nit done: `warnings` is pinned `List.unmodifiable`.
- **Router endpoints (thread 2, option a).** The prefix verdict's fatal scope now mirrors the family branch exactly: fatal only when the endpoint carries a dialect verdict (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect(baseUrl) != null` — the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints); routers and unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a warning ("this endpoint carries no dialect verdict … routing key"). gh-1570 fail-fast is preserved on the vendor endpoints in both directions. {"content":"# gh-1624 rework — review threads addressed

## Issues/Notes

- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqplU`** — `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` were rendered only on the `FA_PROVIDER_*` boot notice; the provider-queue chain and the `--model`/`--base-url` revalidation dropped them (silent riders). **Fixed.**

- 💡 **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqptD`** — `docs/agents/providers.md` over-broadened the family verdict's scope (it fires only on the three family-exclusive endpoints, never on routers). **Fixed.**
- The remaining 3 open conversations in `pr_discussions_raw.json` carry no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` and are machine notices (review-verdict record, rework-consume audit, and the APPROVE summary comment) — not reply targets, nothing to fix in code.

## Approach

- **Warnings on every resolve path (thread 1).** `buildProviderQueueChain` gained a `warnings` out-channel (the `skipped` pattern) emitting render-ready `warning: binding — <entry>: <note>` lines; all three queue rebuild sites render them — boot (`ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)` → the provider-queue boot notices in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`), REPL queue reload (`_rebuildProviderQueueRuntime`), and `/provider queue test`. `_revalidatePartialOverride` now returns the effective binding's warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` carries them as a new `bindingWarnings` report field and the boot prints them (`warning: binding — …`, next to the other restore warnings). Warnings the active `FA_PROVIDER_*` binding already carries are deduped so the preconfig notice never double-prints. Secondary nit done: `warnings` is pinned `List.unmodifiable`.
- **Router endpoints (thread 2, option a).** The prefix verdict's fatal scope now mirrors the family branch exactly: fatal only when the endpoint carries a dialect verdict (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect(baseUrl) != null` — the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints); routers and unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a warning ("this endpoint carries no dialect verdict … routing key"). gh-1570 fail-fast is preserved on the vendor endpoints in both directions. The minor is done too: the three catalog-scan copies collapsed into one shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint(baseUrl)` helper (`_validateWireEndpoint`, `_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`, the prefix verdict); `_knownCatalogEndpoint` removed. The line-366 doc claim ("unknown ids, routers and unknown endpoints pass") is true again.
- **Docs (thread 3).** `docs/agents/providers.md` states the exact scope (both verdicts fire only on api.anthropic.com / api.openai.com / generativelanguage; routers never carry a verdict — `claude-*` on an openai-completions binding over OpenRouter passes) and names where the warning renders; README, `--help` text and the CHANGELOG entry updated to the same scope.
- TDD throughout: each thread reproduced by a failing test first (the OpenRouter probe reproduced the thread's exact `ConfigException`), then the minimum fix turned it green.

{"content":"# gh-1624 rework — review threads addressed

## Issues/Notes

- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqplU`** — `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` were rendered only on the `FA_PROVIDER_*` boot notice; the provider-queue chain and the `--model`/`--base-url` revalidation dropped them (silent riders). **Fixed.**
- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqpo9`** — the "known endpoint" scoping kept the vendor-prefix verdict fatal on known ROUTER endpoints (OpenRouter's canonical ids are `anthropic/claude-*`/`google/gemini-*` → still exit 64), contradicting the doc claim "routers … pass". **Fixed via option (a).**
- 💡 **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqptD`** — `docs/agents/providers.md` over-broadened the family verdict's scope (it fires only on the three family-exclusive endpoints, never on routers). **Fixed.**
- The remaining 3 open conversations in `pr_discussions_raw.json` carry no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` and are machine notices (review-verdict record, rework-consume audit, and the APPROVE summary comment) — not reply targets, nothing to fix in code.
- CI was green at rework start; no merge conflicts.

## Approach

- **Warnings on every resolve path (thread 1).** `buildProviderQueueChain` gained a `warnings` out-channel (the `skipped` pattern) emitting render-ready `warning: binding — <entry>: <note>` lines; all three queue rebuild sites render them — boot (`ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)` → the provider-queue boot notices in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`), REPL queue reload (`_rebuildProviderQueueRuntime`), and `/provider queue test`. `_revalidatePartialOverride` now returns the effective binding's warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` carries them as a new `bindingWarnings` report field and the boot prints them (`warning: binding — …`, next to the other restore warnings). Warnings the active `FA_PROVIDER_*` binding already carries are deduped so the preconfig notice never double-prints. Secondary nit done: `warnings` is pinned `List.unmodifiable`.
- **Router endpoints (thread 2, option a).** The prefix verdict's fatal scope now mirrors the family branch exactly: fatal only when the endpoint carries a dialect verdict (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect(baseUrl) != null` — the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints); routers and unknown/private endpoints carry the mismatch as a warning ("this endpoint carries no dialect verdict … routing key"). gh-1570 fail-fast is preserved on the vendor endpoints in both directions. The minor is done too: the three catalog-scan copies collapsed into one shared `_matchingCatalogEndpoint(baseUrl)` helper (`_validateWireEndpoint`, `_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`, the prefix verdict); `_knownCatalogEndpoint` removed. The line-366 doc claim ("unknown ids, routers and unknown endpoints pass") is true again.
- **Docs (thread 3).** `docs/agents/providers.md` states the exact scope (both verdicts fire only on api.anthropic.com / api.openai.com / generativelanguage; routers never carry a verdict — `claude-*` on an openai-completions binding over OpenRouter passes) and names where the warning renders; README, `--help` text and the CHANGELOG entry updated to the same scope.
- TDD throughout: each thread reproduced by a failing test first (the OpenRouter probe reproduced the thread's exact `ConfigException`), then the minimum fix turned it green.

{"content":"# gh-1624 rework — review threads addressed

## Issues/Notes

- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqplU`** — `ProviderModelBinding.warnings` were rendered only on the `FA_PROVIDER_*` boot notice; the provider-queue chain and the `--model`/`--base-url` revalidation dropped them (silent riders). **Fixed.**
- ⚠️ **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqpo9`** — the "known endpoint" scoping kept the vendor-prefix verdict fatal on known ROUTER endpoints (OpenRouter's canonical ids are `anthropic/claude-*`/`google/gemini-*` → still exit 64), contradicting the doc claim "routers … pass". **Fixed via option (a).**
- 💡 **Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sqptD`** — `docs/agents/providers.md` over-broadened the family verdict's scope (it fires only on the three family-exclusive endpoints, never on routers). **Fixed.**
- The remaining 3 open conversations in `pr_discussions_raw.json` carry no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` and are machine notices (review-verdict record, rework-consume audit, and the APPROVE summary comment) — not reply targets, nothing to fix in code.
- CI was green at rework start; no merge conflicts.

## Approach

- **Warnings on every resolve path (thread 1).** `buildProviderQueueChain` gained a `warnings` out-channel (the `skipped` pattern) emitting render-ready `warning: binding — <entry>: <note>` lines; all three queue rebuild sites render them — boot (`ProviderQueueRuntime.build(onBindingWarning:)` → the provider-queue boot notices in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`), REPL queue reload (`_rebuildProviderQueueRuntime`), and `/provider queue test`. `_revalidatePartialOverride` now returns the effective binding's warnings; `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` carries them as a new `bindingWarnings` report field and the boot prints them (`warning: binding — …`, next to the other restore warnings). Warnings the active `FA_PROVIDER_*` binding already carries are deduped so the preconfig notice never double-prints. Secondary nit done: `warnings` is pinned `List.unmodifiable`.
